title: Heracleion: The Atlantis That Was Real
topic: The rediscovery of the submerged ancient Egyptian port city of Thonis-Heracleion
hook: For over a thousand years, historians thought this city was merely a myth invented by the Greeks.
caption:
For twelve centuries, scholars dismissed the legendary port of Heracleion as a myth. Then in the year 2000, underwater archaeologists uncovered titanic statues, temple ruins, and sixty-four sunken ships resting silently on the Mediterranean seabed. What else is hiding beneath the waves?
